results.note: No English translation found for Applicatio. This shorter rhetorical/devotional work has not been translated from the Latin.
Some poems from Carmina varia are included in Thomas Stehling's 'Medieval Latin Poems of Male Love and Friendship' (Garland, 1984, pp. 30-39), with Latin text and English translation.

De gemmis (also titled Liber lapidum) has English translation by C.W. King, published in John M. Riddle's scholarly edition 'Marbode of Rennes' De lapidibus: Considered as a Medical Treatise' (2007), which includes text, commentary, and King's translation.
No separate English translation found for De lapidum naturis. This brief work may be a variant or companion piece to De gemmis but does not appear in English translation.
No English translation found for De ornamentis verborum, a rhetorical work on figures of speech. Modern editions exist in Latin and Italian but no English version located.
No English translation found for De tribus inimicis (On Three Enemies). Despite being a well-known medieval moral work, no English translation appears to exist.
No English translation found for Decem capitula (Liber decem capitulorum). Modern Latin critical editions exist but English translation is not available.
No English translation found for Diplomata. This brief work of uncertain content has not been translated to English.

Some of Marbod's epistolae are available in English via the Epistolae project at Columbia University (epistolae.ctl.columbia.edu), including letters to Ermengarde of Anjou and Matilda of Scotland, but this does not represent a complete English translation of the full epistolary collection.
No English translation found for Passio S. Mauritii (Passion of St. Maurice). Despite Marbod's prominence as a hagiographer, this specific passion narrative has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Passio S. Victoris (Passion of St. Victor). Despite its subject's prominence in medieval hagiography, no English version located.
No English translation found for Passio SS. Felicis et Adaucti (Passion of Saints Felix and Adauctus).
No English translation found for Poema de septem Machabaeis (Poem on the Seven Maccabees). This biblical-historical poem has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Prosa. This brief work (211 words) has no known English translation.
No English translation found for Sermo in vitam S. Florentii (Sermon on the Life of St. Florentius). Despite Marbod's renown as a preacher, this sermon has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Versus de S. Laurentio (Verses on St. Lawrence). This poem (0 words in source) does not appear to have an English translation.
No English translation found for Vita B. Maurilii (Life of Blessed Mauriliu/Maelus of Angers). A modern Latin critical edition exists but no English version is available.
No English translation found for Vita S. Gualterii (Life of St. Walter). Despite Marbod's fame as a hagiographer, this particular life has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Vita S. Licinii (Life of St. Licinus). No English version of this saint's life exists.
No English translation found for Vita S. Magnobodi (Life of St. Magnobod). This hagiographic work remains untranslated to English.
No English translation found for Vita S. Roberti (Life of Blessed Robert of Arbrissel). While a modern critical edition was published (Degl'Innocenti, 1995), it is in Latin only.

No English translation found for Vita S. Thaisidis (Life of St. Thaïs), despite the work's fame as inspiration for Anatole France's novel and Jules Massenet's opera. The life itself has never been translated to English.
No English translation found for Vita Theophili metrica (Metrical Life of Theophilus). This poem (0 words in source) does not appear to have an English translation.
No English translation found for Bulla de canonizatione S. Cunegundis. This papal bull exists in Latin in Migne but has not been translated to English.

Regesta sive epistolae 1: Only partial English translations exist. Cheney & Semple's 'Selected Letters of Pope Innocent III Concerning England (1198-1216)' covers only England-related correspondence, not the complete register.
Regesta sive epistolae 2: Only partial English translations available. Same limitation as volume 1 - no complete translation of the full register exists.
No English translation found for Prima collectio decretalium. This canonical compilation exists in Latin but has not been translated to English.
Regesta sive epistolae 3: Only partial English translations available via Cheney & Semple (England) and other selections. No complete English translation of this volume exists.

Registrum super negotio Romani imperii: Only partial English translations available. K. Pennington has translated some portions, but a complete English translation of the register does not appear to exist.

De contemptu mundi (also De miseria condicionis humane) has multiple copyrighted English translations: Donald R. Howard/Margaret Mary Dietz ed. (Bobbs-Merrill, 1969) and Robert E. Lewis ed. (1978). Both are modern scholarly editions with full English translation.
No English translation found for De omnibus Sanctis (On All Saints). This brief work (166 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for De quadripartita specie nuptiarum (On the Four-fold Kind of Marriage). This substantial theological work (16,855 words) remains untranslated to English.
No English translation found for De vita et passione Domini Nostri Jesu Christi (On the Life and Passion of Our Lord Jesus Christ). This brief work (301 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Dialogus inter Deum et peccatorem (Dialogue Between God and a Sinner). The Latin text is available online but no English translation has been published.
No English translation found for Encomium charitatis (Encomium of Charity). This work (892 words) remains untranslated to English.

No English translation found for Encomium de B. Virgine Maria et filio eius Jesu Christo (Encomium of the Blessed Virgin Mary and Her Son Jesus Christ). This brief work (343 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Hymnus. This work (337 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Libellus de eleemosyna (Little Book on Almsgiving). Despite its pastoral significance (5,650 words), this work remains untranslated to English.

No English translation found for Mysteria evangelicae legis et sacramenti eucharistiae (Mysteries of the Gospel Law and the Eucharistic Sacrament). This substantial theological work (58,207 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Prologus (Prologue). This brief work (713 words) has not been translated to English.

Sermones communes: Only a few selections have been translated to English. One sermon (Sermon 34) appears in Ray C. Petry's 'No Uncertain Sound' anthology, but the complete collection of sermons has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Sermones de diversis (Sermons on Various Occasions). This substantial collection (16,119 words) remains completely untranslated to English.
No English translation found for Sermones de sanctis (Sermons on the Saints). This large collection (57,250 words) has not been translated to English.
No English translation found for Sermones de tempore (Sermons on the Seasons/Church Year). This substantial collection (52,497 words) remains untranslated to English.
No English translation found for Supplementum ad Regesta Innocentii III. This supplementary register (81,755 words) has not been translated to English.
